purpose: Self-contained data handoff for another AI to continue the personal spending classification workflow. No additional source files are needed to read the current ledger and decisions. Original documents are required to independently verify extraction.

reading_guide.authoritative_current_ledger: entries. This is the combined working ledger; sum included_spending_brl once. Other sections are alternate representations or evidence, never additional transactions.
reading_guide.amount_format: All BRL amounts are decimal strings with a dot separator. Use decimal arithmetic, not binary floating point. IDs are strings.
reading_guide.date_basis: MP card report_month is invoice month, while date is purchase date. Other sources use transaction month. January invoices include 2025 purchases.
reading_guide.source_representations: Earlier source-specific ledgers preserve extraction and bank-specific fields. Their classifications may be older than entries, especially the MP account ledger. Current entries override those older classifications.
reading_guide.classification_rules: Saved user decisions. Apply source/matching restrictions, handle refunds first, and allow later user corrections to override. Purchase-specific and reviewed-record rules do not generalize to all transactions at a marketplace.
reading_guide.review: pending_review contains 95 grouped items. Existing UNKNOWN - CHECK entries remain pending. The user instruction to discard blank answers applied only to the returned 39-row JM table, not all unknown entries.
reading_guide.certainty: Included totals contain both user-confirmed and inferred classifications. Read basis/status per entry. Product matches marked possible are not confirmed identities.
reading_guide.interaction: User prefers one question at a time, or a table with one blank answer column. Apply each response, save the rule and update derived totals. Do not ask again about deferred items unless the user resumes them.
reading_guide.preservation: Preserve raw sources and exclusions. Discard means exclude from spending, not delete records. This export has not been uploaded or shared externally.

user_objective.focus: Calculate spending by practical and user-defined categories, not reconcile inflows and outflows.
user_objective.exclusions: Internal transfers, overseas remittances, physical-dollar purchases, crypto, card bill settlements, yields, refunds/cancellations, lottery group payments, specified Uber PENDING charges, the payment to the brother, and returned JM blank answers. Scope is determined by individual saved rules.
user_objective.categories: Preserve custom categories such as JohnnyBravo, JohnnyBravo-eva, Home Office, HOME SPENDINGS, PERSONAL and their user-defined subcategories. Vivo PERSONAL / HOME is a mixed label, not an assumed allocation.
